name: bell
description: BELL — a fully-collateralised, no-liquidation market for closed-session equity gap risk on tokenised equities

scripts.build: tsc -b calibrator/tsconfig.build.json settlement/tsconfig.build.json indexer/tsconfig.build.json && npm run build -w @bell/web
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p calibrator/tsconfig.json && tsc -p settlement/tsconfig.json && tsc -p indexer/tsconfig.json && tsc -p web/tsconfig.json && tsc -p tools/tsconfig.json
scripts.verify: npm run build && npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run architecture && npm run test
